content:
Target's Black Friday sale may not start until November 27, but it's already showing off some promising LEGO deals for shoppers to check out. Mainly, in the Pokémon lineup. The retailer currently has the builds of Pikachu and a Poké Ball, Munchlax, Arcanine, and SMART Play sets of Mewtwo’s Lab Break and Drone Search for Mythical Mew on sale ahead of its main event, with discounts stretching up to 40% off.

Save up to 40% on Select LEGO Pokémon Sets at Target

Of the sets on sale, Munchlax is the one that's hit this 40% off mark, while the others hover around 20% and 10% off. However, it's worth noting that for builds like the Arcanine and Pikachu, their deal prices are the lowest we've seen on them so far. That certainly still makes them worth checking out right now if they've been on your radar.

If you're hoping to pick up one of these LEGO sets for someone you know as a holiday gift, it's also worth keeping in mind that their age ratings vary. The Pikachu, Arcanine, and Munchlax builds are all geared towards adult builders (likely because of more complex assemblies, higher piece counts, and being meant as display pieces), while the SMART Play sets have age ratings of 8 and 10.

IGN's Jada Griffin also wrote up a We Build on the Pikachu and Poké Ball set, which is worth having a look at to learn more about its assembly, if you're curious. In it, she wrote that it's an "incredibly fun build and a wonderful addition to my collection," so it certainly seems worth picking up while it's still on sale.

There's sure to be many more LEGO deals to come as we get closer to official Black Friday sales, too. While Target's starts on November 27, Amazon and Best Buy are kicking off their respective sale events even earlier on November 19 this week, so we'll be keeping an eye out for what they have in store as well.
